headline: Trump says he ‘convinced’ Nvidia board to reinstate Jensen Huang

members.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
members.lead: Chipmaker reverses decision it made to remove chief executive after reports of affairs including with alleged Chinese spy Business live – latest updates Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive in a stunning reversal after his dramatic resignation after reports of extramarital affairs including with an alleged Chinese spy. Nvidia shares surged on the news, jumping 33% and adding more than $1tn to its market value, in New York on Monday, while Donald Trump, who had called for Huang’s return, said “the country needs Jensen’s leadership”. members.title: Trump says he ‘convinced’ Nvidia board to reinstate Jensen Huang
members.lead: President says he spoke with board ‘directly and indirectly’ and assured them on national security risks Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang – latest updates US politics – live updates Donald Trump said on Monday that he spoke “directly and indirectly” with Nvidia’s board and “convinced them” to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive. “I’ve been speaking to the board directly and indirectly, and I felt very strongly about it,” Trump said on CNBC. “And I felt more strongly as I saw what was happening with the company, because that was, to me, a very important part of our country.
